import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', 
                         hue='BMI Category', s=100, alpha=0.7, ax=ax1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax1.legend(title='BMI Category', title_fontsize=11, fontsize=10)

# 2. Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
occupation_metrics = df.groupby('Occupation').agg({
    'Sleep Duration': 'mean',
    'Quality of Sleep': 'mean',
    'Stress Level': 'mean'
}).sort_values('Sleep Duration', ascending=False)

x = np.arange(len(occupation_metrics))
width = 0.25
ax2.bar(x - width, occupation_metrics['Sleep Duration'], width, label='Sleep Duration', alpha=0.8)
ax2.bar(x, occupation_metrics['Quality of Sleep'], width, label='Quality of Sleep', alpha=0.8)
ax2.bar(x + width, occupation_metrics['Stress Level'], width, label='Stress Level', alpha=0.8)

ax2.set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Average Score', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax2.set_xticks(x)
ax2.set_xticklabels(occupation_metrics.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=10)
ax2.legend(fontsize=10)

# 3. Distribution of Physical Activity Level by Gender
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
violin = sns.violinplot(data=df, x='Gender', y='Physical Activity Level', 
                        hue='Gender', dodge=False, inner='quartile', ax=ax3)
ax3.set_xlabel('Gender', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Physical Activity Distribution by Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax3.legend().remove()

# 4. Correlation Heatmap of Numerical Features
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
numerical_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                  'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
correlation_matrix = df[numerical_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(correlation_matrix, dtype=bool))
heatmap = sns.heatmap(correlation_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', 
                      cmap='coolwarm', center=0, square=True, 
                      cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8}, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_title('Correlation Matrix of Health Metrics', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)

# 5. Sleep Disorder Distribution by Age Group
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
df['Age Group'] = pd.cut(df['Age'], bins=[15, 25, 35, 45, 55, 65], 
                         labels=['15-25', '26-35', '36-45', '46-55', '56-65'])
disorder_by_age = df[df['Sleep Disorder'].notna()].groupby(['Age Group', 'Sleep Disorder']).size().unstack()
disorder_by_age.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=ax5, alpha=0.8)
ax5.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax5.legend(title='Sleep Disorder', title_fontsize=11, fontsize=10)
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# 6. Daily Steps vs Heart Rate by Stress Level
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
scatter2 = sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Daily Steps', y='Heart Rate', 
                          hue='Stress Level', size='Stress Level', 
                          sizes=(50, 200), alpha=0.6, palette='viridis', ax=ax6)
ax6.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Daily Steps vs Heart Rate by Stress Level', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax6.legend(title='Stress Level', title_fontsize=11, fontsize=10, bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Adjust layout and save
plt.suptitle('Sleep Health & Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
